csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Linq; using System.Reflection; using System.IO; public class Script { public static void Main() { var all = Object.FindObjectsByType<GameObject>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None); var hs = all.Where(go => go.name.Contains("Highway_8000")).OrderBy(go => go.name).ToList(); var lines = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(); foreach (var go in hs) { var road = go.GetComponents<Component>().FirstOrDefault(c => c.GetType().Name == "ERModularRoad"); if (road == null) { lines.Add(go.name + " : no road"); continue; } var t = road.GetType(); var mc = t.GetMethod("GetMarkerCount", BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Instance); var mp = t.GetMethod("GetMarkerPosition", BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Instance); string o = go.name + " : "; if (mc != null && mp != null) { int n = (int)mc.Invoke(road, null); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) o += mp.Invoke(road, new object[]{ i }) + " | "; } else { o += string.Join(",", t.GetMethods().Select(m => m.Name).Distinct().ToArray()); } lines.Add(o); } File.WriteAllLines("C:/Zombera/highway_markers.txt", lines); } }
